question: Dilwara Temple is one of the finest and architecturally renowned ______ temples in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jain.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dilwara Temple** is located in **Mount Abu, Rajasthan **and is one of the most famous **Jain temples** in India.
 
• **It was built between the 11th and 13th century AD and is known for its intricate marble carvings and architecture.**
 
• The temple complex consists of five temples, each dedicated to a different **Jain Tirthankara.**
 
• **The temples are a fine example of the Solanki style of architecture and are known for their exquisite marble work, intricate carvings, and beautiful sculptures.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhist temples are known for their peaceful and serene atmosphere.**
 
• Some of the famous buddhist temples in India are **Mahabodhi Temple, Mahaparinirvana Temple, Ramadhan Stupa Temple, and Wat Thai Temple.**
 
• Hindu temples are known for their grandeur and elaborate rituals.
 
• Some of the famous hindu temples in India are **Venkateswara Temple, Tirumala Tirupati, Simhachalam Temple, Kanaka Durga Temple, Golden Vimana of Srisailam Temple.**
 
• Sikh temples are known for their community service and langar (free food for all).
 
• **Some of the famous sikh temples in India are Golden Temple, Gurudwara Shri Guru Nanakji, Hemkund Sahib, Gurudwara Bangla Sahib.**
